$description: TeachingBubble (platform/components/TeachingBubble, library wave 5, lane A): its component tokens. The surface, arrow and widths are Popover's (md, lg when wide); the buttons are Button's.

teaching-bubble-media-margin-block-end.$description: TeachingBubble: the space under the picture.

teaching-bubble-header-gap.$description: TeachingBubble: the gap between the title and Close.

teaching-bubble-header-min-height.$description: TeachingBubble: the header is at least as tall as Close (the inline-action role).

teaching-bubble-title-font-size.$description: TeachingBubble: the title's size (Popover's title size).

teaching-bubble-title-line-height.$description: TeachingBubble: the title line is as tall as Close (the inline-action role), so its first line centers on the button without an offset.

teaching-bubble-text-margin-block-start.$description: TeachingBubble: the space between the header and the text.

teaching-bubble-footer-gap.$description: TeachingBubble: the gaps in the footer (between the actions, and before the step count).

teaching-bubble-footer-margin-block-star.$description: TeachingBubble: the space above the footer.
